name: יַחֲזִיאֵל
summary: Five men: a Benjamite who came to David at Ziklag (1Ch 12:5); a priest who blew the trumpet before the ark (1Ch 16:6); a Levite, third son of Hebron (1Ch 23:19; 24:23); a Levite of the sons of Asaph on whom “the spirit of Yahweh came in the midst of the assembly”, who told Jehoshaphat, “stand still and see the salvation of Yahweh with you” (2Ch 20:14–17); and the father of Shecaniah among those who returned with Ezra (Ezr 8:5). The name is the imperfect of חָזָה with אֵל, “God sees”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Upon יַחֲזִיאֵל … came the spirit of Yahweh in the midst of the assembly.”
“Stand, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you.”
Among the Benjamites who came to David at Ziklag.
A priest with trumpets before the ark.
“The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third.”
“Of the sons of … Shecaniah son of Jahaziel.”
“His eyes behold (יֶחֱזוּ)”: the imperfect of the verb, of God.

note: Takes h.bp.al (6 tokens); j.be.ah is a zero-token cross-reference. TIPNR's Jahaziel@1Ch.12.4 is 1Ch 12:5 in the Hebrew numbering. Ezr 8:5 names him only as Shecaniah's father; the Hebrew has lost a family name before him.
